描述_EN: the two cylinders, probably chariot fittings, date to the western han dynasty (206 bc-ad 8), while the bases and the zoomorphic mount were added many centuries later, maybe between the song and early ming dynasties (1368-1644). the particular favour for archaic bronzes and jades encouraged the production of contemporary objects in an 'archaic' style. fakes also made their appearance as a consequence of the growing demands in the art market. a red and green patination, applied at the end, gave the surface a uniform 'archaic' appearance. this bronze vase is a composite object made of several parts inlaid with gold and silver and soldered together. from the song dynasty (960-1279) the fashion of collecting and display works of art for their aesthetic value was very widespread among chinese scholars, officers and wealthy men.
描述_ZN: 两个圆柱体，可能是战车的配件，可以追溯到西汉时期（公元前206年-公元前8年），而底座和放大镜是在许多世纪之后添加的，可能是在宋朝和明朝早期（1368-1644）之间。 年，对古代青铜器和玉器的特别青睐鼓励了以 "古代 "风格生产当代物品。 年，由于艺术市场的需求不断增长，赝品也开始出现。 年，在最后涂上了红色和绿色的铜锈，使其表面呈现出统一的 "古代 "外观。 年，这个青铜花瓶是一个由多个部分镶嵌金银并焊接在一起的复合物品。 年¥从宋朝（960-1279）开始，在中国的学者、官员和富人中，因其审美价值而收集和展示艺术品的时尚非常普遍。
